connectionId.description: Optional id of a data warehouse connection (e.g. Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, Redshift). When set, the query runs live against that source instead of the ClickHouse catalog, and may only reference that source's tables. Discover connection ids with external-data-sources-connections-list, then list a connection's tables by running `SELECT table_name FROM system.information_schema.tables` with that connectionId set.

context.description: Why this query runs, and the governed-catalog outcome behind it. Write "governed catalog consulted: no match" here only after a catalog check found no approved metric for the measure: a `metric-list` call, or a metric listing that your instructions provide. Without that check, leave the phrase out. This rides alongside the query and never reaches the person who asked, so catalog bookkeeping belongs here instead of in the answer.

properties.description: Complete property-filter objects from the editor, including type, key, operator, value, and group_type_index for group filters. Preserve all fields and boolean values; the backend validates each filter.

filters.description: Structured filters applied through SQL filter placeholders. When working in the SQL editor, copy current_query_node.source.filters here and preserve {filters} in each relevant source scan. Keep dateRange, properties, and filterTestAccounts unless the user asks to change them. Pass an empty object to clear filters. Not supported with sendRawQuery.

query.description: The final SQL query to be executed.

sendRawQuery.description: Send `query` to the connection verbatim instead of compiling it from HogQL first. Use this for SQL only that connection's own engine understands, such as vendor-specific functions. Requires connectionId, and works only on a pure direct connection (access_method 'direct'), not on a synced source with live queries enabled. The connection is read-only and accepts a single statement.

truncate.description: Whether to truncate large blob/JSON values in results. Defaults to true. Set to false when you need full untruncated results (e.g., for dumping to a file).
